svg.aria-label: AgentRQ task timeline: under a task, a dot lands for every status it enters, with the time spent on the line to the next. claude picks up Migrate users table, waits on you to allow a command (a yellow needs-input stretch), later is blocked until you reply (a red stretch), and completes it; the totals read claude-code worked 14m, blocked 3m, needs input 2m, start to close 19m, and claude celebrates.
